# T-2: Bootstrap official presets

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make bundled official presets available before setup renders preset candidates for a fresh project.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Fresh setup candidates include official preset contributions.
- Official source resolution failure produces a fatal setup error.
- The pre-prompt bootstrap path reads official preset metadata without writing target config or installed package state.
- The pre-prompt bootstrap path reads at most the official plugin manifest and bounded preset contribution metadata.

## Implementation Notes
Use `officialPresetPluginRoot()` and official source resolution as the source of truth, but keep pre-prompt discovery manifest-only/read-only instead of calling config-writing installation helpers. Do not bootstrap arbitrary non-official plugin sources.

## Test Strategy
Integration-test fresh setup candidate display against a temp project. Unit- or integration-test official source failure by overriding the official source root.
